answer: For summit and jetty sky agents, require one reserved certified chip per ID/day to sign zenith-radiance reports. A registry checks vendor certificates, fresh ID/day signatures and one ID per chip/day; failure denies listing. This proposal assumes honest one-identity-per-chip certification. Ten IDs need ten chips despite shared hosts or parallel signing. Chips are reusable capital; leasing costs recur; no stake. Spare chips cheapen IDs, and signatures do not establish sensor truth.
